children: Dell Technologies booked a record $60.9 billion in AI server orders during 2Q, the company said. AI-optimized server revenue hit $16.4 billion for the quarter, doubling year over year. The company exited the quarter with a $95 billion backlog, reflecting sustained enterprise demand for AI infrastructure. Chief Operating Officer Jeff Clarke said customers are treating IT environments as value drivers that fuel growth.
